title: Marangoni swimmer-spread loop 4, four paired seeds: in the escape-disc environment the heritable Marangoni coefficient rises more than in the identical-event twin on 4 of 4 seeds (late trait mean +7.6, +7.2, +3.4, +0.4 ladder units), but the share of dividing rods that swim 3 of their own lengths rises more on only 1 of 4 and the selection gradient on distance per cycle is never positive: the environment selects the trait, not the capability
summary: Fresh seeds 502 and 503 of the question's design (c45's self-copied mar 20/40/60 ladder, all founders mar 40, trait-blind mutation, growing sink discs) paired with seeds 500 and 501 from loops 1-2. E vs identical-event twin: the trait mean averaged over t >= 1000 is higher in E on all four seeds (mean +4.7) and the mar-60 kind holds 10-47% of bodies late vs 3-38%; the M-gate share (3 own rod lengths with the rear tip advancing) is higher in E only on seed 501 (5/9 vs 2/10; others 1/17 vs 2/17, 4/19 vs 4/17, 1/10 vs 1/10), and E's gradient of descendants on distance per cycle is +0.00, +0.04, -0.11, -0.13. Kind changes happen at logged mutations (2 exceptions of 72), off-kind daughters 1-5 per 34-58, births and disc deaths continue to the end with 6-21 bodies. Together with loops 1-3 (fast discs and food flashes reward speed, and faster rods divide sooner), this campaign finds that selecting the Marangoni coefficient does not select distance per cycle in this world; it names environments that might.

finding.operator: heritable Marangoni-coefficient ladder (self-copied surfactant kinds) with trait-blind mutation in growing sink discs
finding.control: identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) on four paired seeds 500-503
